text_block_list.text:
—So busy. With the fiscal year-end 
approaching, work piled up in no time, 
making the past few days utterly hectic.
choice_data_list:
(Ah, I need to go take care of the 
paperwork soon!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hi, trainer! Wanna grab some food during 
our break—
choice_data_list: （あっ、そろそろ手続き行かないと！）
choice_data_list_en: (Oh, I'd better go take care of the paperwork soon!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Oops! What, you heading out?"
choice_data_list: Sorry, it's for work. I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: How are you getting back?
choice_data_list: ごめん、仕事で。いってきます！

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...—Hmph. How boring.
choice_data_list_en: At night! I'll still be reachable, so...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—And it's just work, work, work! I don't 
even have time to play around!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'd suffocate. Being a Trainer sounds 
like such a drag~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Having no time to spend with my 
precious partner is beyond boring!

text_block_list.name: Sweet Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Our Valentine's campaign is underway~! 
Would you care to sample our new 
chocolates~?

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, tomorrow's 
Valentine's Day, huh. Maybe I'll buy 
something for myself~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Valentine's Day――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I have a great idea! Hey, I've got a 
favor to ask!"

Today, like any other day, it's work time. 
The paperwork is piled high enough to make 
my head spin, but this is all for Tap 
Dance City. Gotta hang in there...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, my first mate!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's a present! Let's head out right now!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hop on! I'll show you an incredible, 
top-notch view!"
(*Vroooooom*)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Woooo!! How exhilarating!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ripping full throttle feels great, right! 
The wind, the sound of the waves, the 
scent of the tide! Plus, everywhere you 
look is pure blue!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Let's blast off one more time!

We thoroughly enjoyed the winter sea for a 
while on the boat steered by Tap Dance 
City—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"There! Over there! That one, that 
shooting game!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You can challenge it in pairs of two. If 
you set a new record, the prize is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I snagged ten whole massive boxes of 
snacks! You in or what?
choice_data_list: Yeah! We're definitely taking that win!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Alright, we won! Treasure acquired!!

—Suddenly looking up at the sky, the sun 
has completely set. I spent almost the 
entire day playing around...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—We made good time! Onto the next one, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: （やばい、仕事ほったらかしだ……！）
choice_data_list_en: (Oh no, I left all my work sitting there...!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Of course! Now hurry up! Let's go!

Tugged forcefully along by the arm, I 
found myself led to a completely deserted 
riverbank.
choice_data_list: Umm, what are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Just you watch.
choice_data_list_en: Umm, what are you doing here...?

text_block_list.text: (――*whistle...*)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Whooo! Awesooooome!

—It was a magnificent fireworks display. 
One by one, great flowers of light 
blossomed across the clear winter sky.

"...Still, I've never heard of a fireworks 
display happening around this time of 
year. As I'm wondering about it—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――Guess that means the treasure's all ours 
to share.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I used a friend's connection. I asked them 
to set off some prototype fireworks for 
us. ...Did you like them?

"...Come to think of it, when she took me 
out, she said it was 'a Valentine's 
gift.'"

She probably just wanted to give me a 
break, concerned about how overworked I've 
been.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's make a promise, my 
treasure—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Don't go making me feel lonely now.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It'd be boring if we didn't spend time 
together, right? Even today, I just wanted 
the two of us to have fun together.
choice_data_list:
......Sorry for leaving you alone for so 
long.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No biggie. I'm a generous captain, so I'll 
let it slide!
choice_data_list: ……ごめん、ずっとほったらかしで
choice_data_list_en: ...Sorry for leaving you alone for so long.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Work's been keeping you busy, hasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That said, we've got a party after this! 
Our friends are all gathering for us.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So today, forget all about work! Let's 
party hard and make some noise!!

—And so, I enjoyed a dinner party 
alongside Tap Dance City and her friends.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It'd be boring if we didn't spend time 
together, right? Even today, I just wanted 
the two of us to have fun together.

She seemed to be having so much fun with 
her friends that I never imagined she felt 
lonely. When I tell her this, her face 
instantly scowls.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? What are you talking about? That has 
nothing to do with this!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm saying it sucks that I can't hang out 
"with you"!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Speeding across the water on a boat, 
aiming for the giant prize, and watching 
these fireworks together! I set all of 
this up because I wanted to do it with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――Because there's no one who could ever 
replace you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, you must make time to hang 
out with me! Got it?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: So, when can we play next?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"NEXT weekend?! That's too far away! Let's 
hang out tomorrow too!"
choice_data_list: えーと……来週末はどうだ？

text_block_list.text:
"Bickering playfully with cries of ‘I 
wanna play more!’ and ‘But work comes 
first...’, they both enjoyed the treasure 
they had all to themselves."
